title: gomphandra pauciflora
intro: Gomphandra pauciflora, commonly known as East Indian oak or Pacific oak, is a plant species within the Guttiferae family. This plant is valued for its traditional medicinal uses, particularly in Southeast Asian cultures, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Gomphandra pauciflora include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing pain, inflammation, and the risk of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
